processing: Source 0.6 m NAIP RGB, lossless 1.2/2.4 m working COGs, bilinear reprojected WebP levels. Airport detail samples approximately 1.4 m; regional detail approximately 2.8 m. Source OSM sea polygons preserve 241 island holes. Alpha denotes unavailable coverage; no generated replacement pixels and no runtime external imagery service. Historical event water masks additionally include the pinned tidal Hudson source; original photographs and their content identities are unchanged. Shared by JFK operations and the US1549 scene; scene identity does not duplicate photography or tidal masks.
